steps.title: Implement selective execution
steps.description: Run only explicitly selected steps. Preserve the rest for later turns.
steps.complexity_reason: Selection must survive saved drafts and retries.

comments.text: Keyboard users must be able to select and inspect steps.

steps.title: Preserve progress between turns
steps.description: Save partial completion without resetting unfinished work. Sample progress.
steps.complexity_reason: Completed work and remaining scope must stay consistent.

steps.title: Review selection and progress
steps.description: A fresh Codex task checks this code snapshot and reports back here.
checks: Only selected work runs; remaining steps stay available.
Notes, removal, undo, and saved drafts still work.
Stale requests, retries, and failed submissions behave correctly.
Relevant tests pass and cover these behaviors.
steps.done_when: All checks have evidence for the reviewed snapshot, with no blocking findings.

steps.title: Polish mobile interactions
steps.description: Refine touch targets and wrapping on narrow screens.
steps.done_when: Selection and review controls fit and remain usable at 320px.
steps.complexity_reason: Limited changes to established layout and controls.
